text:
maria: Quick callout — enabling FP8 kernels on L40S for atlas-13b canary. Throughput +45% but eval RNLL increased by ~1.8% vs our INT8 baseline. Config below, curious if this rings any bells.
kevin: Is this AWQ or GPTQ path? Also what exact FP8 format (e4m3/e5m2)?
maria: AWQ pipeline -> then runtime FP8 kernels (e4m3). Using batch 8, seq 1024. Canary eval is our standard toxic+qa holdout.
sushma: 1.8% RNLL is... borderline. Can you paste the short diff sample outputs? often it's a tokenization/artifact thing.
maria: Pasting config + small log snippet:
```
model: atlas-13b
quant: awq+runtime-fp8
fp8_mode: e4m3
batch_size: 8
seq_len: 1024
tiling_stride: 128
kv_tile: 256
fallback_policy: allow-int8-on-saturation
```
log: perf: 45% throughput up, eval_rnll: 3.42 -> 3.48 (+1.8%), ans_accuracy: 87.2 -> 86.1 (-1.3%)
dmitri: Two quick suspects: 1) kv-cache tiling mismatch between our FP8 kernel and AWQ's quant layout. 2) activation scaling / saturation on long sequences.
kevin: also check vector widening flags. our L40S FP8 kernels historically enabled a widening optimization to improve locality; it can change numerical ordering and produce small deltas.
alex: H100 vs L40S FP8 math differs; H100 kernel uses 32-bit accumulation in some paths while L40S sometimes keeps narrower accum. That can surface on long attention windows. Try forcing 32-bit accum if possible.
ci-bot: Canary run 2166004450 finished: link: https://ci.internal/canaries/2166004450 — metrics attached.
sushma: Quick experiments to try (in priority):
- Run with fp8_accum=fp32 forced
- Increase kv_tile to 512 to align tiling with AWQ layout
- Run short-seq vs long-seq split to see distribution of regressions
- Disable vector_widening optimization
dmitri: If the issue concentrates on long inputs, consider enabling our fp8_fallback_policy: degrade-to-int8-for-long-kv to keep tail latency but preserve quality. That buys time while we root cause.
maria: Trying fp8_accum=fp32 + kv_tile=512 now on canary B. Will post numbers.
ops-bot: Heads-up: do not promote this canary to prod until quality delta <0.5% or rollback flag present. Use rollout flag: rollout.fp8.enable=false to revert quickly.
maria: canary B numbers: throughput +40% (slightly lower than A), eval_rnll: 3.43 -> 3.44 (+0.3%), ans_accuracy 87.2 -> 86.9 (-0.34%). Looks much better with fp32 accum + kv_tile aligned.
kevin: sweet. That points to accumulation path + tiling mismatch as culprits. Dmitri, can we add a small autotune that sets kv_tile to match AWQ layout for that model family?
dmitri: Yes, we can add a model profile override and a quick runtime heuristic: if quantized-with-awq then prefer kv_tile 512 on L40S. I will open a tiny PR.
alex: Also add a smoke test to the canary job to run long-seq prompts. That would have flagged this earlier.
sushma: Good catch. Also add a note to the fp8 enablement runbook: "always validate with long-seq synthetic suite and forced 32-bit accum sanity check."
maria: Thanks all. Will keep the canary pinned and run broader eval. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Rollout staged flag set to hold.
ci-bot: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/2221
kevin: Nice. Once PR lands, let's re-run the AWQ+FP8 full sweep (short/medium/long) and collect per-token KL and sample diffs.
maria: On it — will update when sweep completes.
